title: Wayfare Pass Plan Schedule — Annual Commitment Discount
content:
# Annual commitment discount — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

A member moving up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual from an annual plan is rewarded for annual renewals already paid. The annual commitment discount counts the annual renewals the member has paid, being renewal fee charges less those refunded as duplicate charges: 5 percent for a member on an annual plan with at least 2 paid annual renewals, 2 percent for a member on an annual plan with exactly 1, nothing otherwise.

| Plan held at the move | Paid annual renewals | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| annual plan (Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual) | 2 or more | 5 percent |
| annual plan | exactly 1 | 2 percent |
| annual plan | none | nothing |
| monthly plan (Wayfare Pass Student, Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly) | any | nothing |

**Counting paid renewals.** The membership fee charges with reason renewal on the membership ledger, less the number of fee refunds with refund basis duplicate charge. Initial charges, trial conversion charges and plan change charges are not renewals.

**Effect.** The discount is taken off the All Access upgrade charge as that percentage of the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00; the percentage is of the 249.00 fee itself, the amount taken off is not rounded on its own, and the charge is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Examples (hypothetical).**
- Wayfare Pass Annual member with 3 renewal charges and 1 duplicate-charge refund: 2 paid renewals, 5 percent, 12.45 taken off.
- Wayfare Pass Plus Annual member with 1 renewal charge: 2 percent, 4.98 taken off.
- Wayfare Pass Monthly member with 20 renewal charges: nothing.
